title: Revisiting the 2012 NFL replacement officials, from lockout to 'Fail Mary'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Revisiting the 2012 NFL replacement officials, from lockout to 'Fail Mary'
sources.description: The NFL is set to hire, and potentially use, replacement officials for the 2026 season. Here's a look at the last time they tried that in 2012.
